name: Dranzer V2
description: Dranzer V2: a Balance phoenix with two unique abilities and one Special.

ability.name: Twin Phoenix Wings
ability.description: After a successful Attack, launches an additional strike. Additional strike deals 22% of the original hit's damage. Cooldown: 2 rounds.

special_move.name: Double Phoenix Cyclone
special_move.description: Performs 2 consecutive hits. Each hit deals 80 + 38% ATK. First hit reduces enemy DEF by 12% for 2 rounds. Second hit benefits from the reduced DEF. Cooldown: 4 rounds.

abilities.name: Twin Phoenix Wings
abilities.description: After a successful Attack, launches an additional strike. Additional strike deals 22% of the original hit's damage. Cooldown: 2 rounds.

abilities.name: Rebirth Flame
abilities.description: When HP would reach zero, survive with 20% maximum HP. Removes all removable debuffs. Gains 15% ATK for 2 rounds. Activates once per battle.
